description: This file defines a React component 'TenantSelection' that displays a list of tenants fetched from an API, allows the user to select a tenant, and then navigates to a dashboard. It manages state for tenants, loading, and error handling, and interacts with external utility functions for API calls and tenant ID normalization.

methods.name: TenantSelection
methods.description: React functional component that renders the tenant selection UI, fetches tenant data on mount, and handles tenant selection.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch tenant data and update state, with cancellation support.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles tenant selection, calls API to set tenant, and redirects to dashboard.
